prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
For a small business, **Otterly.AI** looks like a practical starting point: it’s designed for smaller teams, tracks whether your business appears in answers from ChatGPT and other AI search tools, and its entry plan is reported at about **$25–$29/month**. Check its current plan details before signing up, since pricing and engine coverage can change.

If you only want a **free, one-time baseline**, try **HubSpot’s AI Search Grader**. It can give you a quick snapshot, but it won’t provide ongoing monitoring.

A useful caveat: these services test a set of prompts on a schedule; they can’t guarantee what every person will see. For a local business, track realistic questions customers might ask—such as “best [service] near [town]”—and compare results over time. Sources: [Otterly.AI overview](https://zapier.com/blog/best-ai-visibility-tool/) · [HubSpot AI Search Grader overview](https://www.softwaresuggest.com/blog/best-ai-visibility-tools/)
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
